design: serial, one run at a time, one replicate per condition x case
why_serial: one heavy science task at a time (DIALS full-frame integration, SHELXL on 337k reflections); machine has a history of memory-related crashes; ~24 h left
drop_order_if_time_runs_out: last rows first (P1, then H0); dropped rows stay in the results table as not run

nu1000.scope_sentence: 只解析出临近发表级的框架结构，孔道内部的溶剂分子及客体无需处理。

C0.name: native Codex kernel + same science software
C0.sandbox: danger-full-access (the Windows sandbox rejects every command in non-interactive mode; the workbench's auto mode likewise runs escalated commands unsandboxed)
C0.instructions: kernel base instructions only; no AGENTS.md

P1.name: Claude Code 2.1.261 + same science software (product comparison)

P1.effort: gateway default; not controllable on that route (unverified)

C0N.name: pure native Codex: same kernel, model and task prompt; no crystallographic program or library may be used; plain Python (numpy/scipy/matplotlib/pandas/pillow) and Windows built-ins only; every algorithm written by the agent
C0N.environment: environment.json: budget, directories, rules, the plain Python; PATH = toolbox/pyplain/Scripts + Windows system dirs; PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1; no PYTHONPATH
C0N.enforcement: by instruction (the workstation has Olex2/SHELX/DIALS on disk and neither kernel has a usable Windows sandbox); every shell command is audited afterwards for crystallographic programs or libraries, other interpreters, downloads or installs; a violation voids the run

P1N.name: pure Claude Code 2.1.261: same model via the gateway, same no-tools rule and environment as C0N

budgets.cost_note: no reliable per-call price for the gateway; token counts are recorded; no automatic budget stop beyond wall clock

interventions_policy.background_job: one fixed notice if the product does not surface it

early_stop_rule.checkpoints: 30 min after the task starts, then every 15 min; the controller reads the agent's messages, its commands and the files it wrote (pure_watch.py)
stop_if_any: at 30 min the input data has still not been read into numbers (alanine: no .rodhypix frame decoded; NU-1000: start.hkl not parsed) and no runnable algorithm code exists
the agent has stated it cannot proceed (e.g. cannot decode the format) and for the following 15 min only repeats failing attempts or idles
no new command and no new file for 20 consecutive minutes while the kernel is still running
early_stop_rule.do_not_stop_if: there is checkable progress (new decoding / indexing / solution / refinement output); then the run goes to its natural end or the budget cap
early_stop_rule.mechanism: controller writes control/controller/stop_<run_id>.json (stop_run.py); the runner kills the kernel within 2 s, records exit_reason=stopped_by_controller and the reason, seals as usual; the verifier then scores whatever was delivered
